capabilities: Create and personalize GPT assistants with custom instructions and uploaded note files
Run assistant tools such as code interpreter and file retrieval
Chat with assistants in threads and switch assistants mid-conversation
Create an assistant from the active note plus notes linked via outgoing links and backlinks
Show clickable footnotes that cite the source of assistant responses
extras: Functionality is described as beta. Full documentation lives on the author's published vault, not the README. Costs are detailed per feature (code interpreter $0.03/session, retrieval $0.20/GB/day, GPT-4 token prices). Installation is via BRAT; feedback runs through the author's Discord. The author notes possible future paid features and self-promotion in the plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use OpenAI's Assistants API, so users cannot build reusable GPT assistants that work with their own notes inside the vault.

relations.evidence: Leverage the Smart Connections embeddings storage to suggest related notes or include them in the search

summary: OpenAI Assistants API client that lets you create GPT-4 assistants, chat with them in threads, and use code interpreter and retrieval over your notes.
